Circle.meta_description: The brands and organisations supporting One For The Girls, and how to partner with us.
Circle.title: We bring the community
Circle.intro: We partner with brands, businesses and suppliers to bring new experiences and activities to our community.
Circle.glance_text: Our audience includes Bangkok-based women (mostly between 25 and 35 years old) from a mix of backgrounds, nationalities and industries who are actively looking for new places to go, things to do and brands to discover.

audience.label: are on a short-term stay or split their time between cities

Circle.why_intro: Our events give brands the opportunity to:

why.desc: Introduce your brand directly to women in Bangkok.

why.title: Create real-life experiences
why.desc: Let our community experience your product, service or venue first-hand.

why.title: Reach new potential customers
why.desc: Put your brand in front of women who are actively looking to discover and try new things.

why.title: Create authentic content and exposure

Hello.meta_description: Get in touch with One For The Girls about events, partnerships or collaborations.
Hello.title: We'd love to hear from you
Hello.intro: Questions about an event, a partnership idea or just want to say hi? Drop us a message.

faqs.q: Who can join One For The Girls?
faqs.a: Every woman is welcome. Our community brings together Thai and international women in Bangkok.

faqs.q: How do I book an event?
faqs.a: Each event has its own booking link on our What's On page. Spaces can be limited, so book early.

faqs.q: Can I come on my own?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Plenty of girls come solo and leave with new friends.

faqs.q: I'm a brand. How can we work together?
faqs.a: Take a look at Our Circle for the options, then send us a partnership enquiry.
